title: Quarkus unable to launch when both quarkus.datasource.db-kind and quarkus.datasource.driver are set
body:
I am trying to integrate h2 DB with quarkus. I refereed documentation from the quarkus web site and written a sample application that have one rest controller, which call save operation on h2 database.
But while trying to launch application in dev mode(mvn compile quarkus:dev). I am getting below exception.
